CustomField.description: Estimated Hours / Day Totals for Consulting Services
CustomField.formula:
IF( TEXT(NSP_Hourly_Day_Rate__c) == "Day",
(IF(SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c>1, TEXT(SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c) & " " & TEXT(NSP_Hourly_Day_Rate__c) & "s", TEXT(SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c) & " " & TEXT(NSP_Hourly_Day_Rate__c) ) ),
(IF(SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c>1, TEXT(SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c) & " Hours", TEXT(SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c) & " Hour") ) )
CustomField.label: Estimated Hours / Day Totals
